title: Balayage in Staten Island, NY | Hair & Makeup by Gerta
description: Hand-painted balayage for a soft, sun-kissed finish, by Gerta Lila at Le Vigne Hair Salon in Staten Island, NY. Call or text to book.
intro: Hi, I’m Gerta Lila, a hair stylist and makeup artist at Le Vigne Hair Salon in Staten Island, where I’ve worked for about seven years. Balayage is hand-painted color for a soft, sun-kissed finish, and I’d love to create yours.

photos.alt: Long blonde balayage waves seen from the back, in a salon
Long brunette hair with caramel pieces and loose waves, seen from the back
Shoulder-length layered cut with caramel highlights, seen from the side

blocks.text: I paint the color onto your hair by hand and place the lighter pieces where the sun would naturally catch them. That way it looks soft and blended rather than stripy.

Balayage suits you if you want brightness and dimension that still looks natural. It can work on many hair colors and lengths, from dark brunette to blonde. I’ll look at your hair first and tell you honestly what will work for it.

We start by talking about the look you want, and photos of colors you love help a lot. Then I paint the color, let it work, and finish with a wash and a style, so you leave ready to go. A balayage appointment takes about 3 hours.

items: Wash with a shampoo and conditioner made for colored hair, in lukewarm rather than hot water.
Use a heat protectant before you blow-dry, straighten or curl.
If your balayage is blonde, a purple shampoo now and then helps keep brassy tones away.
Protect your hair from strong sun, and rinse it after a swim in a pool or the sea.

blocks.text: What is the difference between balayage and highlights?
Highlights are placed in foils to add brightness, depth and dimension. Balayage is painted on by hand for a softer, sun-kissed look. I do both, so I’ll help you choose.
Can I have balayage on dark hair?
Yes. How light we can go depends on your hair, and I’ll tell you honestly what to expect before we start.
Photos of colors you love, and of any you don’t. They help me see exactly what you have in mind.

blocks.html: Call or text me at 347-671-5095, or send me a message on Instagram or Facebook. I’m at Le Vigne Hair Salon, 644 Forest Ave, Staten Island, NY 10310, Tuesday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM. Prices are set by the salon, so just ask when you book.
You’ll find all my services on the Services page, and more photos in the Gallery.
